author: PMniac
what_it_is: JCCP 100% - Everything unlocked and awesome times at Gourmet Race.
format: Wii data.bin (an SD-card export; header AES-128-CBC with the SD key, header MD5 valid): title 00010001-JCCP "Kirby's Fun Pak", 1 file: savedata.bin 8192 bytes - savedata.bin is the SNES SRAM

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/wiivc-convert.py convert kirby-super-star.24072.bin OUT: decrypts the data.bin (AES-128-CBC, SD key, per-file IVs) and takes savedata.bin (8192 bytes): the SRAM, as is
verified.baseline: with no save: the three files at 0% (the game formats SRAM at first boot)
